policy: The catalogue card is the hard identity goalpost. Generated references clarify construction, roof topology, courtyard continuity, materials, and occupied depth without changing the architecture.
elevation_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked architectural reference elevation for a modular 3D building family
Input images: Image 1 is the sole hard design reference for identity, proportions, materials, openings, and construction rhythm.
Primary request: Create a rectified, orthographic, straight-on public street elevation of the exact same Modern Brick Mews courtyard-family-housing building shown in Image 1.
Subject: Preserve the same three occupied wall levels (one ground level plus two upper residential levels), the long golden-buff brick street wing, its exact calm domestic bay rhythm, black powder-coated steel Juliet balconies, recessed dark-framed windows and balcony doors, soldier-course brick bands, a grouped brick-arched ground-floor carriage/bike-storage zone, and the dark grey pitched concrete-tile roof with restrained skylights. The main carriage arch must be a true deep passage through the street wing toward the courtyard, not a dark painted window.
Scene/backdrop: isolated complete facade on a plain light warm-grey studio background with a narrow neutral ground strip; no adjacent buildings, trees, vehicles, people, street furniture, or signage.
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic architectural survey photograph, physically plausible materials, subtle natural variation, no illustration or concept-art stylization.
Composition/framing: entire facade visible edge to edge, centered, zero perspective convergence, camera perfectly perpendicular, no cropping, generous margin around roof and base.
Lighting/mood: soft overcast shadow-neutral illumination suitable for albedo and facade registration; no directional cast shadows or sunset color.
Materials/textures: fine-scale golden buff brick and mortar, slightly darker soldier-course bands, charcoal metal frames and railings, dark grey concrete roof tiles, restrained warm occupied room depth behind glass.
Constraints: Keep Image 1's architecture and storey count unchanged. Do not add or remove floors, towers, dormers, balconies, bay windows, facade wings, roof forms, or decorative styles. No text, no logos, no watermark.
Avoid: generic apartment block, red brick, white render, blue mirror glass, exaggerated arches, repeated identical glowing windows, painterly finish, dramatic lighting.
aerial_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked architectural roof-and-courtyard reference for a modular 3D building family
Input images: Image 1 is the catalogue identity reference. Image 2 is the approved rectified street elevation of that same building. Treat both as hard invariants.
Primary request: Show the exact same Modern Brick Mews building from a high front-corner aerial angle that clearly proves its complete courtyard plan and roof topology.
Subject: A compact four-wing perimeter building around one real rectangular open-to-sky paved courtyard. The long public street wing must exactly preserve Image 2's three occupied levels, golden buff brick, dark frames, Juliet balconies, soldier courses, grouped ground arches, and deep carriage passage. The carriage passage must continue through the street wing into the courtyard. Side and rear wings use the same three-level buff-brick construction with a quieter related window rhythm and occasional Juliet balconies. Preserve dark grey pitched tiled roofs on all four wings, connected with physically plausible hips/valleys and hidden gutters around the courtyard; add only the restrained skylights supported by the references.
Scene/backdrop: isolated architectural model on a simple warm-grey ground plane, no neighboring buildings, landscaping, cars, people, text, or signs.
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic architectural survey render with physically plausible construction and fine material scale, not concept art.
Composition/framing: complete building and entire courtyard visible, high three-quarter aerial, public street facade facing the viewer, no crop.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral overcast daylight, restrained shadows, no sunset tint.
Constraints: Preserve the exact street facade identity and three-storey count from Images 1 and 2. One uninterrupted open courtyard must remain visible to sky through all wall, cornice, and roof layers. Do not cap the courtyard with a slab. No extra floors, towers, roof pavilions, dormers, glass boxes, or facade styles. No text, logos, or watermark.
Avoid: solid rectangular block, fake painted courtyard, giant atrium roof, generic apartment complex, red brick, white stucco, blue curtain wall, dramatic lighting.
courtyard_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked courtyard-interior construction reference for a modular 3D building family
Input images: Image 1 is the hard authority for public-facade materials, levels and opening language. Image 2 is the hard authority for the four-wing open courtyard and connected roof topology.
Primary request: Show the exact same Modern Brick Mews from inside its paved courtyard, looking toward the inner face of the public street wing and the carriage passage that connects directly to the street.
Subject: Three occupied levels of golden buff brick on all courtyard elevations; one deep central carriage-passage opening through the street wing with visible brick jambs and soffit; quieter dark-framed residential windows; several narrow black Juliet guards; soldier-course bands aligned continuously around all inner corners; simple ground-floor doors and integrated covered bicycle storage; dark grey pitched tiled roofs with eaves and hidden valley gutters above. The courtyard is a real open void with grey unit paving and no roof over it.
Scene/backdrop: isolated architectural survey setting; courtyard architecture fills the frame; no people, cars, trees, planters, furniture, signs or decorative props.
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic architectural survey photograph, physically plausible brick scale, metal profiles, glazing depth and construction joints.
Composition/framing: eye-level wide-angle from the courtyard center, inner public wing centered, both side-wing returns visible, verticals straight, complete passage opening visible.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral overcast daylight entering from the open sky, subtle contact shadows only.
Constraints: Preserve the three-storey count, buff brick, black metal, roof form, courtyard dimensions and public passage established in Images 1 and 2. Keep the passage as a traversable void with clear floor continuity. No extra floors, bridges, atrium roofs, towers, exterior stairs, balconies that block the passage, text, logos or watermark.
Avoid: hotel courtyard, luxury landscaping, generic red-brick apartment, bright blue glass, theatrical lighting, closed passage, painted fake arches.
occupied_depth_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: occupied-depth underlay source for glazing in a real-time architectural model
Input images: Image 1 is the hard authority for the Modern Brick Mews residential palette, occupation level and understated mood.
Primary request: Create a wide orthographic strip of shallow contemporary residential room interiors intended to sit physically behind separate window panes. Show several adjacent believable domestic room-depth cells with restrained variation: pale warm plaster, muted curtains, timber shelving, occasional dark unoccupied rooms, and soft indirect warm interior light.
Scene/backdrop: interiors only, viewed straight-on from outside; no exterior brick facade, no window perimeter frames, no balconies, no roof, no street, no people.
Style/medium: photorealistic architectural interior-depth plate, subtle and low-contrast so exterior glass reflections remain dominant.
Composition/framing: horizontal strip divided into eight loosely aligned room zones, full bleed, straight-on, no perspective convergence; avoid hard visible borders between cells.
Lighting/mood: mostly dim neutral rooms with sparse warm occupation, no bright orange glow, no direct sunlight or cast exterior shadows.
Materials/textures: curtains, matte plaster, dark timber, small restrained furnishings; realistic depth and occlusion.
Constraints: No exterior masonry, frames, mullions, doors, text, logos or watermark. Do not make every room identical or illuminated. Keep brightness low enough for glazing use.
Avoid: storefronts, offices, hotel rooms, neon lighting, blue mirror glass, people, repeated checkerboard windows, dramatic staged interiors.

material_prompts.brick:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless shadow-neutral source texture for a physically based architectural material
Input images: Images 1 and 2 are hard color, brick-scale, bond and weathering references for the exact Modern Brick Mews facade.
Primary request: Create a square, perfectly seamless orthographic material swatch of the same golden buff facing brick and pale warm mortar seen in the references.
Subject: fine contemporary buff brick in a consistent running bond, realistic individual-unit variation from pale straw through muted honey and light tan, narrow slightly recessed mortar joints, rare subtle kiln marks, no damaged bricks, no openings, no soldier courses, no corners.
Style/medium: photorealistic architectural material capture suitable for deriving albedo, normal, roughness, AO and depth maps.
Composition/framing: straight-on flat surface filling the entire square; edges tile perfectly in both axes; consistent brick dimensions and mortar spacing.
Lighting/mood: completely shadow-neutral diffuse capture with no directional light, gradients, highlights, vignette or cast shadows.
Constraints: Match the references' warm golden-buff hue and fine brick scale. No windows, doors, railings, signs, vegetation, objects, text, logos or watermark.
Avoid: red brick, orange brick, oversized masonry units, rustic stone, deep black mortar, dramatic relief, obvious repeating clusters, perspective.
